messages:
kevin: Heads-up — noticed a spike of TLS handshake failures from eu-ingest -> eu-proxy after last night's cert roll. Error: 'tls: unknown certificate authority'.
kevin: This is affecting a handful of customers in eu-west-1; latency spikes and 502s.
maya: ack, thanks. Any recent IAM/RBAC changes applied to the signing service?
jordan: I pushed the CA signing role change for the new HSM rotation last night (PR merged ~02:10 UTC). It removed the old 'signer:legacy' binding and added a scoped role to projects/*/ingest.
kevin: Logs show sign requests from eu-proxy were denied with: `permission denied: kms.sign not granted for principal serviceAccount:proxy@eu-prod`
sam: Looks like the regional proxy is still using the global service account. We scoped the role to regional projects to meet compliance, but forgot to update the proxy SA mapping.
kevin: That explains the 'unknown certificate authority' — the proxy couldn't get the cert signed, so it fell back to cached cert which expired.
maya: Can we do an emergency mitigation? Option A: rebind legacy signer role temporarily. Option B: patch proxies to use regional SA and trigger a fresh sign.
jordan: For speed, rebind legacy role for 30m with an audit-scoped exception. I'll create an IAM exception and add an expiration.
kevin: Also need to confirm audit logs captured the denied sign attempts — right now our SIEM only shows generic 403s.
auditbot: sys: Detected repeated KMS API failures: resource=projects/eu-west-1/kms/ca-key action=kms.encrypt status=403 count=18 first=1947212360 last=1947213302
maya: Sam, can you scope the proxy change? We want a follow-up to pick the safer path (regional SA).
sam: On it. I'll push a canary to eu-proxy of the SA mapping and update the bootstrap script. Command I'll run in staging: `gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding proxy-sa@eu --member="serviceAccount:eu-proxy" --role="roles/kms.signer"`
kevin: After we rebind, we should also rotate the ephemeral certs to ensure new chains are issued. Use `rctl cert issue --ca=regional-eu --subject=eu-proxy --ttl=1h`
jordan: I'm creating the short-lived IAM exception now and adding an audit label: `iam:bindings/exception=eu-proxy-emergency-2026-03-20`
jordan: PR link: https://git.internal/r/iam/exception-247 (adds temporary binding + expiry meta)
maya: Good. Post-mitigations: 1) update proxy bootstrap to regional SA 2) add a policy test to CI that verifies `kms.sign` for all service mapping 3) add an alert on repeated KMS 403s with per-service breakdown
kevin: We should also enhance audit logging: include `request.project_id` and `service_account` in our log export to BigQuery so we can pivot quickly. Right now those fields are sometimes missing.
auditbot: sys: Export job status: bigquery-export (kms-logs) last-run=1947209000 status=SUCCESS rows=12456
sam: I'll add the request fields to the export transform. ETA 3 hours.
jordan: For compliance, Security Ops wants an incident timeline doc and proof we scoped the exception. I'll create a short incident thread and tag legal.
maya: After we fix, plan a permanent change: CA hierarchy with regional intermediate CAs signed by global root (root key in HSM with strict RBAC), so proxies can validate chain without remote signing.\evm: 
kevin: Agree — regional intermediate avoids cross-region signing timeouts and limits blast radius. Action items:
- jordan: post IAM exception + expiration (done) + link to PR
- sam: patch proxy SA mapping and deploy canary to eu-staging (in progress)
- maya: add CI check for kms.sign on service mappings (todo)
- kevin: update audit export to include request fields (in progress)
- all: schedule a design doc for regional intermediate CA by EOD Friday
jordan: exception created, expires=1947215945, audit_label=eu-proxy-emergency-2026-03-20, PR attached.
sam: canary deployed to eu-staging, looks good; planning eu-prod rollout with 10% traffic shift in 15m.
kevin: once prod canary is healthy, rotate certs on eu-proxy and confirm zero 502s.
maya: postmortem checklist: include who approved IAM exception, why scoped roles caused outage, and follow-up to automate SA mapping on rotation.
kevin: Thanks team. I'll update product incidents channel once we confirm customer impact numbers. :thumbsup:
